description: Free and lightweight Git tools: inline blame, file history, conflict resolution, local merge and commit graph.
config.blame.enabled: Show the blame of the current line and enable the file blame.
config.blame.format: Text shown at the end of the current line. Variables: `${author}`, `${date}` (relative), `${message}` (first line), `${sha}` (7 characters).
config.blame.statusBar: Show the author and date of the current line in the status bar.
config.blame.maxLines: Files with more lines than this have no blame.
color.blameForeground: Color of the blame text at the end of the current line and in the file blame.
config.history.enabled: Show the File History view in the Git Forge sidebar.
config.conflicts.enabled: Show the Conflicts view during a merge, rebase, cherry-pick or revert with conflicts.
config.merge.enabled: Add the Merge Locally command (fetch, update both branches, merge, optionally delete the merged branch).
command.conflicts.keepAllOurs: Keep Mine for the Whole File
command.conflicts.keepAllTheirs: Keep Theirs for the Whole File
config.compare.enabled: Show the Compare, Stashes and Worktrees views in the Git Forge sidebar.
config.graph.enabled: Show the commit graph (Git Forge sidebar, and Show Graph in an editor tab).
command.graph.mergeBranch: Merge Locally into the Current Branch…
config.operations.enabled: Add cherry-pick, revert, reset and interactive rebase to the commit menus of the graph and the File History view.
config.rebaseEditor: Open `git rebase -i` todo lists in Git Forge's rebase editor (when VS Code is your Git editor, e.g. `git config --global core.editor "code --wait"`). Adds or removes the `workbench.editorAssociations` entry for `git-rebase-todo`.
command.reset: Reset the Current Branch to This Commit…
